Name: Eating food or crops restores health and stamina over time plus enables sprinting
Author: abslam
Description:
[size=5]The mod adds 2 fully customizable mechanics with controller support:[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4]Health and Stamina regeneration buffs after eating:[img]https://i.imgur.com/094HlVq.gif[/img][/size]
[*][size=4]Sprinting (Because you know. Gotta go fast):[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9W5vyFx.gif[/img]﻿
[/list]
Both mechanics are fully customizable with the config.json file, here are the defaults:

{
  "SprintingEnabled": true, // Enables or disables the sprinting mechanic. [code]false [/code]to disable it.
  "SprintingSpeed": 3, // Speed gained when sprinting. the bigger the number the faster you go.
  "SprintingConsumesStamina": true, // If sprinting consumes stamina. [code]false [/code]to disable stamina drain when sprinting.
  "StaminaConsumedWhenSprintingPerSecond": 10.0, // Units of stamina per second consumed.
  "StaminaDrainingDecreasesWithPhysicalSkillLevels": true, // for each foraging, mining and combat level the stamina consumption decreases 0.2 being 6 at max level. [code]false [/code]to disable skills reducing the stamina draining.
  "StaminaRegenerationIncreasesWithPhysicalSkillLevels": false, // If you want to scale the amount of stamina regenerated per second with foraging, mining and combat levels
  "FoodNeededToRegenStamina": true, // You need to eat food to regenerate stamina. [code]false [/code]if you don't want to eat to start regenerating stamina.
  "StaminaRegenerationEnabled": true, // By default you regenerate stamina after eating. [code]false [/code]if you don't want to regenerate stamina at all.
  "FoodNeededToRegenHealth": true,  // You need to eat food to regenerate health. [code]false [/code]if you don't want to eat to start regenerating health.
  "HealthRegenerationEnabled": true, // By default you regenerate health after eating. [code]false [/code]if you don't want to regenerate health at all.
  "SecondsToRegainStaminaAfterUsingIt": 5,  // Seconds in which you won't gain stamina after performing an action that decreases it.
  "RemoveHealthRegenerationAfterGettingHit": true, // By default if you get hit the buff of health regeneration will dissapear. [code]false [/code]if you want to keep the buff after being hit
[img]https://imgur.com/f466V66.gif[/img]
  "SecondsToRegainHealthAfterGettingHit": 5, // Seconds in which you won't gain health after being hit.
  "StaminaRegenerationPerSecond": 5.0, // Total of stamina gained per second if the buff is active
  "HealthRegenerationPerSecond": 5, // Total of stamina gained per second if the buff is active
  "HoursRegeneratingHealthAfterEating": 2, // The duration of the buff in "In-Game hours"
  "HoursRegeneratingStaminaAfterEating": 2, // The duration of the buff in "In-Game hours"
  "SprintKey": "LeftShift", // Key to activate the sprint (you have to hold it), if you want to change it pick one of this [url=https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.input.key?view=netframework-4.8]Key constants[/url]﻿ by default it's left shift, you will have to change the ingame "run" key to any other for the sprint to work (the run key walks by default).
  "SprintButton": "LeftStick", // Button to activate the sprint (you have to hold it), by default it's clicking the left stick. if you want to change it, pick one of this [url=https://imgur.com/JKR4Xp5]buttons[/url]﻿.
  "RegenPercentajeOfFood": [b]true[/b], // Regenerates a percentage of the stamina and health of the food instead of a flat value
  "PercentajeOfFoodStatsRegenerated": [b]5.0[/b], // The amount of health and stamina regenerated per second of the food eaten now can be with decimals! [img]https://i.imgur.com/UhySHJR.png[/img]﻿ in 1.1.2
}
